dna_summary: One family, many tools. Every palette keeps our v1 DNA: a soft, light background (never saturated or dark) filling 50-80 % of the frame, soft mids from our clay family (cream, peach, sand, tan, sage), a dark warm ink for lines and captions (at least 7:1 on the background), and from the owner's references one saturated HERO on the subject (5-15 %), a deep tinted ANCHOR instead of black (~5 %) and at most one tiny hot POP for 'look here' (1-3 %). #1 is v1 as shipped, #2 the incremental polish, #3-8 sister palettes for different stories. Pick one per video (a sister palette may carry a deliberate shift, e.g. a cozy interior vs a dusk exterior); extend or add palettes when a topic needs it.

palettes.name: 1 Mint & Clay (v1)
palettes.mood: As shipped in video 1. The reference point; the owner loves it.

palettes.name: 2 Mint & Clay 1.1
palettes.mood: The incremental polish of v1: same world, a cleaner saturated teal hero, a deeper anchor, a tiny marigold pop.

palettes.name: 3 Cream & Cobalt
palettes.mood: Our cream as the page (like the references), cobalt hero, our orange as the pop. Tech, clear explainers.

palettes.name: 4 Blush & Pip
palettes.mood: Blush page, periwinkle hero (Pip's colour), aubergine anchor. Human, light, brand moments.

palettes.name: 5 Sage Study
palettes.mood: Cozy enclosure: a lamp-lit interior, sage and oat, deep forest anchor, amber pop. Home, desk, quiet scenes.

palettes.name: 6 Dusk
palettes.mood: Evening version of the family: cool mist, a low peach sun, indigo hero, coral pop. Serious, night, high stakes.

palettes.name: 7 Autumn Ochre
palettes.mood: Our clay family turned warmer: ochre sun, burnt-orange hero, a small cool blue pop (a screen glow). Money, everyday life.

palettes.name: 8 Harbour
palettes.mood: Cool, fresh page with a warm coral hero, deep sea anchor, sunny pop. Science, health, the outdoors.
